subject: POC acceptance criteria, owners, and exec readout scheduling
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Kline <evan.kline@blueharborhealth.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@blueharborhealth.com>
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-11T13:20:00Z
Subject: Recap + proposed POC acceptance criteria and owners

Hi Evan / Priya — thanks again for a productive discovery today. Quick recap and next steps from our side so we’re all aligned before the trial kickoff: 

Summary of customer goals
- Reduce triage time for clinician notes by 40% (measured as median time-to-first-action)
- Achieve >92% relevance on extracted structured fields (diagnosis, medication, follow-up) compared to their gold set
- Maintain end-to-end 95th percentile latency <= 350ms for single-turn inference under expected test load

Proposed POC scope (6 weeks)
1) Week 0–1: Environment provisioning (VPC peering, test data ingestion, API keys, RBAC) — owner: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
2) Week 2–4: Model tuning + dataset runs (batch + streaming scenarios) — owners: BlueHarbor data team + aditya_rao
3) Week 5: Embedded evals and QA against success criteria — owners: priya.shah@blueharborhealth.com, monica.patel@redwood.ai
4) Week 6: Exec readout and go/no-go decision; deliverables: executive slide deck, cost template, runbook — owners: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, evan.kline@blueharborhealth.com

Acceptance criteria (pass/fail gates)
- Accuracy: structured field F1 >= 0.92 on holdout test set (unit: macro-F1)
- Latency: 95th percentile token/turn latency <= 350ms under target concurrency (20 rps)
- Stability: no more than 1 infra outage >5 minutes during trial window

Attached: draft POC plan, sample dataset manifest, Redwood trial SLA v1. Please confirm owners and the proposed 6-week timeline. Evan — you mentioned an exec check-in in mid-May; what dates work for your leadership?

Thanks — V

--
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0199

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Evan Kline <evan.kline@blueharborhealth.com>
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-12T09:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Recap + proposed POC acceptance criteria and owners

Adding a few technical constraints and recommendations based on today's infra discussion: 

- Data: For evaluation we recommend a ~10k record holdout for structured field metrics and a separate 2k sample for manual spot-checks. Priya — if you can confirm access method (S3 vs. secure upload) we’ll scope ingestion. 
- Network: We'll provision a dedicated VPC endpoint for the trial. BlueHarbor will need to allow outbound to our inference cluster IP range; I’ll send the CIDR block once infra ticket is open. 
- Canary: Suggest a two-phase ramp: 10% traffic for 48 hours (smoke + perf), then full test load. This helps validate KV cache and batching behavior. 

I’ll attach the infra checklist this afternoon. Timelines look realistic but we should pad Week 2 by 2 days for model calibration.

- Aditya
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Evan Kline <evan.kline@blueharborhealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@blueharborhealth.com>, Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@blueharborhealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-13T15:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Recap + proposed POC acceptance criteria and owners

Thanks Vanessa — that looks good. Quick confirmations from our side: 
- BlueHarbor confirms the 6-week window; kickoff earliest 2027-04-26 pending internal sign-off on data access.
- We accept the acceptance criteria listed; Samir will own dataset delivery and Priya will own validation and final sign-off.
- Exec readout: our VP Ops and CTO are available the week of 2027-05-31. Prefer morning PT slots.

Action items for Redwood:
- Finalize the POC plan and send updated doc with the padded Week 2 timeline
- Share CIDR block and ingress requirements for VPC peering
- Provide the executive readout template and a cost worksheet so we can prep internally

Evan
VP Product, BlueHarbor Health

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Kline <evan.kline@blueharborhealth.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@blueharborhealth.com>
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-14T10:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Recap + proposed POC acceptance criteria and owners

Great — thanks for the fast turnaround, Evan. Confirming next steps from Redwood: 
- We’ll update the POC plan to reflect the +2 day padding in Week 2 and re-attach by EOD 2027-04-15 (attachment: 20270415_poc_plan_v2.pdf).
- Aditya — please open the infra ticket and include the CIDR list; put estimated completion by 2027-04-23.
- Monica — can you draft the executive readout template (1 slide: goals & success, 1 slide: metrics + perf, 1 slide: ask / commercial next steps) and share by 2027-04-20?
- Marcus — note for finance: Evan indicated they’ll want the cost worksheet ahead of the exec readout; can we pre-load a draft with the expected committed capacity and optional burst pricing?

Proposed exec readout options (week of 2027-05-31):
- Tuesday 2027-06-01 09:00 PT
- Wednesday 2027-06-02 10:30 PT
- Thursday 2027-06-03 08:30 PT

Evan — please indicate preferred slot and we’ll lock it. Also, we’ll prepare a short SOW addendum for signature (DocuSign link to follow) once the plan is agreed.

Best,
V

--
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-15T18:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Recap + proposed POC acceptance criteria and owners

Thanks — I reviewed Evan’s note. Finance is comfortable with the draft worksheet range; we can offer a pilot discount of 15% on committed capacity for the trial period (BH-2027-042). Monica — I’ll send you the pricing inputs in a separate thread (expected by EOD 4/16).

Two quick asks: 
1) When you post the updated POC plan, include a short section called "Decision checklist" that calls out who signs for go/no-go (Evan for product, Priya for ML validation, Redwood exec for commercial).
2) When you prepare the DocuSign SOW, mark the effective date as the POC kickoff date and include a 30-day payment term for the trial usage invoice.

Good momentum — will circle back once I’ve sent the pricing sheet.

-Marcus
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
